# gocache_dns_records (Data Source)

Lists GoCache DNS records for a domain.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name.

### Read-Only

- `records` (Attributes List) DNS records returned by GoCache. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `cloud` (String) GoCache cloud/proxy status.
- `content` (String) DNS record content.
- `id` (String) DNS record ID.
- `name` (String) DNS record name.
- `ttl` (String) DNS record TTL.
- `type` (String) DNS record type.
